description: This file defines the ConfigurationInterface interface in the AWS SDK, specifically related to use of dual-stack endpoints. It declares methods for checking if dual-stack endpoints are used and for converting the configuration to an array.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: Interface defining configuration options for AWS endpoints related to dual-stack support.

methods.name: isUseDualstackEndpoint
methods.description: Method to determine whether a dual-stack endpoint should be used.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Method to represent the configuration as an associative array.
